messages:
viv: spotted a spike in cross-project KMS grants during the last entitlement sweep. a handful of svcaccts have cloudkms.decrypter across prod+staging :grimacing:

omar: can you dump the principal list? we should check who regranted them and when

viv: heres quick output (sanitized): svc-ci-runner@projA, svc-metrics@projB, svc-legacy-ht@projA. most last-used >120d. ran this against audit logs with a 180d window.

sophia: my worry  is lateral movement if a compromised job token exists. propose: create per-environment keys and move consumption off shared master key. low-risk plan: 1) snapshot policy, 2) schedule canary for svc-ci-runner on staging, 3) monitor decrypt errors for 24h, 4) rotate and revoke old binding.

omear: +1 for canary. set alerts: any AccessDenied >2 in 15m for canary job = rollback. also capture service logs for decrypt failures.

audit-bot: recorded: snapshot created at gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/3344556677/pre-policy.json by viv. ticket KMS-2257 opened (owner=omar).

viv: for compliance we need a one-line justification for each revoke. draft: "reduce cross-project key exposure; replace with per-pipeline scoped keys; retain pre-policy snapshot for audit." can we finalize?

sophia: fine. i'll run the canary tomorrow 09:00 PT and paste canary logs here.

omar: I'll script the rollback commands and add a conditional binding snippet so we avoid full outage during test. posting in the ticket.

viv: cheers. keeping thread for audit evidence. once canary green, we do a 2-week staged rollback. target decision 2026-03-29.
